import hashlib
import subprocess

def run_unsafe(user_cmd, user_id):
    digest = hashlib.md5(user_cmd.encode()).hexdigest()
    query = f"SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = '{user_id}'"
    subprocess.run(user_cmd, shell=True)
